notes.title: What Features are in the in-game Store?
notes.content:
The features in the Store can help to accelerate the game's progress. The Store is unlocked on level 5. 


[b]1. Featured Cards[/b]
You can redeem species cards with gems or drops that you get in the game.

[b]2. Treasure Chests[/b]
You can open chests with gems to get drops and species cards here. There are free chests that refresh every 4 hours.

[b]3. Time Warp[/b]
You can use this feature to speed up progress and get extra resources without spending more time.

[b]4. Drops[/b]
Drops are used to level up cards. You can redeem drops with gems here.


You can acquire gems, drops and energy in Habitats or from the new cards. Tip: Please harvest energy, drops, and gems in the Habitats just before you level up to the next level. Then you can get the most resources in the Habitats.

Hope this is helpful and you can enjoy the game :) Thank you.
